name: future-props-lab
description: 未来道具研究所模型基础设施管理台

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.contracts:generate: uv run python scripts/export_openapi.py && npm run contracts:generate --workspace web
scripts.contracts:check: uv run python scripts/export_openapi.py --check && npm run contracts:check --workspace web
scripts.test: uv run pytest -q && npm run test --workspace web
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check backend db scripts tests && npm run lint --workspace web
scripts.format: uv run ruff format backend db scripts tests && npm run format --workspace web
scripts.format:check: uv run ruff format --check backend db scripts tests && npm run format:check --workspace web
